# Recommended GitHub Labels

Create these labels in GitHub before public issue intake. Colors use six-digit hexadecimal values without `#`.

| Name | Color | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| architecture | `5319e7` | Changes to system boundaries, foundational design, or ADR-governed decisions. |
| bug | `d73a4a` | Confirmed or reproducible behavior that does not meet requirements. |
| documentation | `0075ca` | Documentation additions, corrections, or consistency work. |
| enhancement | `a2eeef` | Improvement to an existing capability or engineering process. |
| epic | `3e4b9e` | Large outcome coordinated through multiple scoped issues. |
| feature | `0e8a16` | Approved new user-facing capability. |
| good first issue | `7057ff` | Bounded contribution suitable for a new project contributor. |
| help wanted | `008672` | Maintainers welcome additional contributor support. |
| mobile | `1d76db` | Flutter, Android, iOS, or mobile-platform work. |
| ml | `b60205` | Model, data, evaluation, MediaPipe, or TensorFlow Lite work. |
| performance | `fbca04` | Latency, memory, battery, thermal, size, or rendering performance. |
| security | `b60205` | Public security hardening work without vulnerability details. |
| testing | `c5def5` | Automated or manual test coverage and quality infrastructure. |
| dependencies | `0366d6` | Dependency, toolchain, action, or supply-chain maintenance. |

Security vulnerabilities must use the private process in `SECURITY.md`, regardless of label availability.
